desc: Jim punches the kitchen table with a container of carrots on it.
Pam, partially hidden in a brown coat, a pink scarf and hat, enters the office and takes off her hat.
Pam drags two trash bins down the driveway in front of a house.
A shot of an office with concrete walls, brick surrounds around the windows, and large windows.
Darryl and a woman talk closely in a parking lot, seen through window blinds.
A person with dreadlocks tightly hugs Darryl, gritting his teeth with a wide smile.
Meredith scratches her head intensely at her desk.
Erin shines a flashlight into Meredith's hair as she leans over the reception desk.
Dwight walks through the door with a threatening expression and throws the cup he's holding in his hand.
Dwight sprays a can of aerosol at people leaving the office.
Angela with a headband shows a tense expression of disgust.
Dwight walks into the office wearing a full yellow hazmat suit with a bag over his shoulder.
Erin in a pink sweater climbs onto a man's back and pushes him onto the desk.
Jim drinks from a champagne glass in the back seat of a car.
Jim takes something from the car and hides it in the inside pocket of his jacket.
Meredith shaves her head with electric clippers in the office kitchen.
A bald Meredith stands in the doorway, screaming and waving her arms.
Jim in a tie answer his phone while a coach waiting with basketball.
Jim talking on the phone reaches for a smoothie from a tray at a basketball court.
Pam pulls groceries from the trunk while talking on the phone, and some items fall and spill on the ground.
Dwight in a hazmat suit stands before seated coworkers as people hand out jars of mayonnaise.
Dwight plays with a pair of scissors and cuts through his hazmat suit.
Angela scoops mayonnaise from a jar and puts it on a man's head.
A bald Meredith rubs mayonnaise into a seated man's hair with a disgusted expression.
Pam sticks out her tongue and frowns in disgust while rubbing the man's head.
A man and Erin with a white substance covering their hair pretend to be gorillas in the office.
A man rubs a white substance into Erin's hair while she spins around.
A bald Meredith grits her teeth in a fierce, angry expression.
Dwight pulls the pin from a can of insect fogger while speaking into a walkie-talkie.
Dwight drops the can, and it explodes, filling the room with a white cloud.
Dwight, half out of his hazmat suit, falls to the floor.
Angela pours water from a pitcher over Oscar's face at the kitchen sink.
Dwight gets into the car, and the dropped can fills it with a white cloud.
A watch, keys, phone, and tie lie scattered on the floor next to a bag.
Pam pours beer into a glass in a bar.
A crowded bar scene with people at the counter with green lamps.
